results.question: which meetup spot got the most new listings in spring 2026?
results.sql:
SELECT ms.name AS meetup_spot, COUNT(*) AS new_listings
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON la.spot_id = ms.spot_id
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON la.listed_on = c.day
WHERE c.semester = 'Spring'
  AND c.academic_year = '2025-26'
  AND la.status = 'available'
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY new_listings DESC
LIMIT 1;
results.answer: Snell Library had the most new listings with 60 during Spring 2026.

results.question: for each category, how many days on average does it take an item to sell?
results.sql:
SELECT la.category,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM d.completed_at - la.listed_at) / 86400)::NUMERIC, 2) AS avg_days_to_sell
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.listings_all la ON la.item_id = d.item_id
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON c.day = d.completed_on
WHERE d.deal_type = 'sale'
  AND d.status = 'completed'
  AND la.is_for_sale = true
GROUP BY la.category
ORDER BY la.category;
results.answer: The average number of days for an item to sell varies by category: bikes_transport (11.20), clothing (11.32), dorm_essentials (11.39), electronics (11.40), furniture (11.61), kitchen (11.49), other (12.08), sports_outdoors (11.56), and textbooks (11.56).

results.question: what share of conversations led to a request, by meetup spot?
results.sql:
SELECT ms.name AS meetup_spot,
       COUNT(*) AS total_conversations,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cv.led_to_request THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS led_to_request_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cv.led_to_request THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS share_percent
FROM nlq.conversations cv
JOIN nlq.listings_all la ON cv.item_id = la.item_id
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON la.spot_id = ms.spot_id
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY ms.name;
results.answer: There are 7 meetup spots in the data, with Curry Student Center having the highest share of conversations leading to a request at 61.45%.

results.question: late-return rate for rentals due during finals compared with rentals due during regular classes
results.sql:

  c.period,
  COUNT(*) AS total_rentals,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN d.returned_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2) AS late_return_rate
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON d.rental_due_date = c.day
WHERE d.deal_type = 'rental'
  AND d.rental_returned_at IS NOT NULL
  AND c.period IN ('classes', 'finals')
GROUP BY c.period;
results.answer: There are 2,742 rentals due during regular classes with a late return rate of 20%, and 134 rentals due during finals with a late return rate of 19%.

results.question: which category has the highest sell-through rate?
results.sql:
SELECT cat.label AS category, COUNT(*) AS sold_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE la.status = 'sold')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) * 100, 2) AS sell_through_percent
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.categories cat ON la.category = cat.category
WHERE la.status = 'sold'
GROUP BY cat.label
ORDER BY sell_through_percent DESC
LIMIT 1;
